heroSubtitle: The definitive hyper-deflationary protocol built on Solana. Harness institutional-grade memory closure mechanics to secure your wallet by reclaiming locked SOL deposits from toxic coins, unused mint accounts, and spam dust.
mechanicsHeading: STATE MEMORY AND RENT-EXEMPTION: HOW THE DESIGN WORKS
mechanicsDescription: On Solana, every data account (such as token mints, metadata, profiles or empty token accounts) requires a minimum deposit in SOL called a Rent-Exempt Balance (about 0.00203 SOL per account) to keep its bytes active on the overall node memory. When you accumulate spam coins, orphaned mints, or leftover unused addresses, this real liquidity is frozen. Our protocol shuts down these unused state channels to return the locked rent SOL back to your active ledger.
mechanicsConstDesc: Account Closure = State Memory De-allocation = Immediate release of 0.002039 SOL per registry slot.

privacyCard2Desc: All reclaimed rent rates adhere strictly to Solana's constant of 0.00203928 SOL per closed state channel. Formula operations are 100% auditable in real-time.
